title: Finite integer combinations of point evaluations are integer multiplicity 0-currents
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and S ∈ 𝒟_0(V) (GeometricCurrentOn V 0). Let M ∈ ℕ, v : ℕ → ℤ and y : ℕ → ℝ^P; the points y_l need not lie in V. Write ⟨α⟩ := α(e) for the value of a 0-covector α on the empty family e : Fin 0 → ℝ^P (Lean: fun i => i.elim0). If S(ω) = Σ_{l<M} v_l ⟨ω(y_l)⟩ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^0(V), then S is integer multiplicity: some degree-0 IMRep R in V represents S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V 0) (M : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℤ) (y : ℕ → Euclid P), (∀ ω : TestFormOn V 0, S ω = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range M, (v l : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) (y l) (fun i => i.elim0)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
